title: Golden Anchor for Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13217v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video generation supports digital content creation, with applications in virtual avatars, AI-driven filmmaking, interactive game engines, and world models. State-of-the-art systems achieve controllability primarily through image-to-video (I2V) generation, in which an injected anchor image determines the identity, composition, and style of the resulting video. In modern pipelines, this anchor is synthesized by a text-to-image (T2I) generator. This raises a largely overlooked question: Are images obtained directly from the T2I model truly suitable for current video models? Our analysis shows that anchor aesthetic and quality scores are weakly correlated with downstream video quality. The structure-and-texture score is negatively correlated with I2V video quality in both the visual and motion dimensions. Fine-tuning the T2I model on an image reward accordingly yields anchors with visibly denser structural and character detail: they score

translated_abstract: 视频生成支持数字内容创作，其应用涵盖虚拟化身、AI驱动的电影制作、交互式游戏引擎和世界模型。最先进的系统主要通过图生视频（I2V）生成来实现可控性，其中注入的锚点图像决定了生成视频的身份、构图和风格。在现代流程中，该锚点由文生图（T2I）生成器合成。这引出了一个很大程度上被忽视的问题：直接从T2I模型获得的图像是否真正适合当前的视频模型？我们的分析表明，锚点的美学和质量分数与下游视频质量仅有微弱的相关性。而结构-纹理分数在视觉和运动两个维度上均与I2V视频质量呈负相关。相应地，基于图像奖励对T2I模型进行微调，可以产生结构和角色细节明显更丰富的锚点：它们的得分……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了文生图模型直接生成的图像并不适合作为视频生成的锚点，并通过基于图像奖励微调T2I模型来生成结构和角色细节更丰富的“黄金锚点”，从而提升下游视频生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that images directly generated by T2I models are not ideally suited as anchors for video generation, and proposes fine-tuning the T2I model with an image reward to produce "golden anchors" with denser structural and character details, thereby improving downstream video generation quality.
